description: Create a report for clear date/client/project/trip/category/merchant criteria. Tags group clients/projects/codes/trips; list_tags if unclear. excludePersonal=true excludes both Personal tag and Personal expense category, as in Report Wizard. Returns summary, exact report/Bill Client links, filters and a prefilled Report Wizard for visual criteria. Optional shareWith recipients (user-named only; emailed). No server preview: creates on call. Group-scoped reports exclude rows on other ordinary reports. No unreported matches: explain existing Reports; never duplicate. Use role-aware accountingHandoffUrls only for the requested destination; opening is not export proof. Complete directly; no check_compliance/get_report_details/tax/deductibility analysis before or after unless explicitly requested.

categories.description: Optional configured expense categories to include in the report.

dateRange.description: One period variant matching user wording.

excludePersonal.description: Exclude expenses whose Tag is Personal or whose Expense Category is Personal.

excludedCategories.description: Expense categories to exclude from the report.

excludedTags.description: Existing ExpenseBot groups to exclude from the report.

recipientRole.description: Access for every shareWith recipient: reviewer for one-report review, comments, approval or changes; accountant only when the user explicitly wants ongoing report management and accounting-software access.

shareWith.description: Email addresses to share the report with

tags.description: Existing ExpenseBot groups to include, such as a client, project, project code, property, or trip. Use list_tags first when uncertain.

name: create_report
